devdoc.details: The controller decides why funds are reserved or slashed. The vault only enforces accounting,      exit, maturity, and solvency rules. User and maker withdrawals remain available while stake      admission is paused.

authorizeDeferredPayout(bytes32,address,.details: Admission is blocked while reservations are paused. Later terminal accounting remains      available to the snapshotted controller even after a pause or controller handover.

clearStakeOwner().details: Existing risk positions remain backed by their snapshotted stake owner. New delegations      stay disabled until the caller explicitly re-enables them, preventing forced reassignment.

params._baseExitDelay: Minimum delay after a full-exit request.
params._controllerChangeDelay: Delay before a proposed controller may accept control.
params._stakeToken: USDC-compatible token held by the vault.

params._amount: Amount of stake token to deposit.

depositStakeFor(address,uint256).details: The caller remains the stake owner and retains all withdrawal rights.

params._amount: Amount of stake token to deposit.
params._taker: Address that may use the caller's stake for future intents.

initializeController(address).details: This one-time path is available only when the constructor controller was address(0).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

requestStakeWithdrawal(uint256).details: The requested amount immediately stops contributing to reservation eligibility and free stake.

params._amount: Amount of stake token to withdraw after the delay.

setAllowedStakeOwner(address).details: This atomically removes a different current assignment, so a taker can recover from      squatting without briefly reopening delegation to every address.

params._stakeOwner: Only address allowed to authorize stake for the caller.

setStakeDelegationEnabled(bool).details: Delegation is enabled by default so a Safe may authorize its relayer in one transaction.      Disabling delegation does not alter an existing assignment; use clearStakeOwner for that.

params._enabled: True to accept future assignments, false to reject them.

setTakerAuthorization(address,bool).details: Existing risk positions retain the stake owner snapshotted at admission.

params._authorized: True to authorize the taker, false to revoke it.
params._taker: Address whose authorization is being updated.

params._authorized: True to authorize every taker, false to revoke them.
params._takers: Addresses whose authorizations are being updated.

stakeOwnerOf(address).details: Takers without a delegation use their own stake.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._intentHash: Intent whose proceeds are being withdrawn.

withdrawDeferredPayouts(bytes32[],addres.details: The batch is atomic and transfers the aggregate amount once.

params._intentHashes: Intents whose proceeds are being withdrawn.

devdoc.title: StakeVault

acceptController().notice: Accepts controller authority after the handover delay.

allowedStakeOwner(address).notice: Returns the only stake owner a taker currently accepts, or zero when assignments are open.

authorizeDeferredPayout(bytes32,address,.notice: Snapshots the current controller for a deferred position before any proceeds exist.

cancelExit().notice: Cancels an outstanding exit request and restores admission eligibility.

cancelStakeWithdrawal().notice: Cancels the caller's pending partial stake withdrawal.

clearStakeOwner().notice: Clears the caller's delegated stake owner for future intents.

constructor.notice: Creates a vault with an initial controller and delayed controller handover.

depositStake(uint256).notice: Deposits membership stake for the caller.

depositStakeFor(address,uint256).notice: Deposits stake owned by the caller and authorizes a taker to use it.

eligibleStake(address).notice: Returns stake eligible for new reservations after a pending withdrawal is excluded.

freeStake(address).notice: Returns eligible stake not currently committed to active reservations.

getExitRequest(address).notice: Returns the full exit request for a staker.

getStakeWithdrawalRequest(address).notice: Returns the pending partial withdrawal for a stake owner.

initializeController(address).notice: Initializes controller authority once after circular deployment dependencies are resolved.

isExiting(address).notice: Returns whether a staker has requested full exit.

proposeController(address).notice: Proposes a delayed two-step controller handover.

recordDeferredPayout(bytes32,address,uin.notice: Accounts for deferred proceeds already transferred into the vault.

releaseDeferredPayoutAuthorization(bytes.notice: Removes an unfunded deferred-position authorization after cancellation.

releaseReservation(bytes32).notice: Releases an active reservation without slashing stake.

requestExit().notice: Requests a full exit and immediately blocks new reservations for the caller.

requestStakeWithdrawal(uint256).notice: Requests a delayed withdrawal of currently unreserved stake.

reserveStake(address,bytes32,uint256,uin.notice: Reserves free membership stake for one risk position.

setAllowedStakeOwner(address).notice: Restricts the caller's future stake assignment to one exact stake owner.

setStakeDelegationEnabled(bool).notice: Enables or disables third-party stake delegation for the caller's future intents.

setStakeOperationsPaused(bool,bool).notice: Pauses new deposits and/or new stake reservations without blocking withdrawals.

setTakerAuthorization(address,bool).notice: Authorizes or revokes a taker's use of the caller's stake for future intents.

setTakerAuthorizations(address[],bool).notice: Authorizes or revokes multiple takers for the caller's stake.

slashDeferredPayout(bytes32,address,uint.notice: Slashes deferred proceeds and credits maker compensation.

slashReservation(bytes32,address,uint256.notice: Slashes part of a reservation, retains remaining coverage, and credits maker compensation.

stakeDelegationEnabled(address).notice: Returns whether a taker accepts new third-party stake assignments.

stakeOwnerOf(address).notice: Returns the stake owner used for a taker's future intents.

updateReservation(bytes32,uint256,uint64.notice: Replaces a reservation amount and maturity after exact release accounting is known.

withdrawCompensation(address).notice: Withdraws all maker compensation credited to the caller.

withdrawDeferredPayout(bytes32,address).notice: Withdraws matured deferred proceeds owned by the caller.

withdrawDeferredPayouts(bytes32[],addres.notice: Withdraws multiple matured deferred payouts owned by the caller.

withdrawRequestedStake(address).notice: Withdraws the caller's requested stake after the delay.

withdrawStake(address).notice: Withdraws the caller's entire remaining stake after the exit delay and all reservations settle.

userdoc.notice: Stable, policy-agnostic USDC accounting for taker stake, reservations, and deferred payouts.
